ideas.pitch: An IoT-based edge controller that dynamically balances load and storage in microgrids using local anomaly detection.
ideas.title: SmartEdge Solar Microgrid Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hardware hackathons heavily favor working physical prototypes; this uses an ESP32 and current sensors to show real-time power switching that judges can physically see and test.

ideas.pitch: A small tracked rover carrying an ESP32-CAM that streams live video and detects structural cracks using edge vision.
ideas.title: Autonomous Pipeline Inspection Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines mechanical mobility with automated computer vision, directly matching the Intelligent & Autonomous Systems domain with a high-impact physical demo.

ideas.pitch: A portable medical triage badge measuring pulse and temperature that runs offline anomaly detection locally to flag critical patient decline.
ideas.title: VitalsEdge: Offline Clinical Triage Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on medical hardware utility in low-connectivity zones, hitting the AI & Healthcare Technologies domain with a self-contained prototype.

ideas.pitch: An ultrasonic water level sensor node powered by a solar panel that reports street-level flood risks to an emergency dashboard.
ideas.title: SmartDrain Urban Flood Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses urban resilience with low-cost hardware components that are trivial to assemble and produce immediate, understandable telemetry data for judges.

ideas.pitch: An accelerometer-based vibration monitor attached to machinery motors that detects early mechanical failure patterns locally.
ideas.title: Industrial Vibration Health Pod
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles industrial maintenance safety, providing a robust end-to-end telemetry system built within a tight 24-hour sprint.
